name: howto
description: Turn a tested feature or a validation sheet into a user-facing how-to document with annotated screenshots, so you can find out whether ordinary users can actually complete the tasks unaided. Always includes screenshots, annotated to show where to click; always delivers both a PDF in the house style and the Markdown source it was built from. Ships the qmsWrapper Documentation PDF pipeline (Chrome print-to-PDF), a highlight-aware screenshot cropper, and the house style.
